summary: Iteration 11 validated the courier navigation modal fix for the 'Iniciar rota' bug. Backend 4/4 tests passing: courier-login (CPF 99988877766), /api/courier/me/orders returns order QZY8PZ with address {street: 'Av. Paulista', lat: -23.5614, lng: -46.6559}, /api/courier/me/order/QZY8PZ detail includes street (so canRoute=true), and assign->accept flow works (PATCH /orders/{oid}/assign-courier with courier_id creates courier_offer.status=pending, POST /orders/{oid}/offer-response {accept:true} sets order.courier and order becomes visible in courier /me/orders). Frontend UI verified end-to-end on mobile viewport (375x667): entregador login via login-mode-entregador → courier-login-cpf/pass/submit, order card entregador-order-QZY8PZ visible in list, tapping opens entregador-order-card with entregador-address 'Av. Paulista, 1000 - Apto 52 / Bela Vista • São Paulo/SP • 01310100'. entregador-start-route button is ENABLED (not disabled), tapping it opens the nav-modal (verified visible) with nav-google (Google Maps) and nav-waze (Waze) buttons both visible + clickable. After starting the route, the entregador-reopen-maps button appears and reopens the same nav-modal successfully. The bug (Alert.alert with 3 buttons not working on RN Web + disabled 'Iniciar rota' when no coords) is fixed.
action_items: None — nav modal fix is verified working end-to-end. Optional: consider auto-refusing stale offers on courier home so leftover pending offers from previous sessions don't block the UI (during test the offer-modal shadowed the order list; refuse worked, so functional but could be more graceful).
critical_code_review_comments: app/(entregador)/index.tsx (620 lines): approaching split threshold (>700). Consider extracting the offer/nav modals and BalRow component into separate files.

startRoute() proceeds with setRouteStarted(true) BEFORE requesting native location permission — if the user denies permission on native, GPS won't run but the UI stays in 'route started' state. On web this is fine (setNavOpen(true) shows the modal immediately). Acceptable trade-off.

buildDest() returns {coords} OR {query}; the Google URL still uses encodeURIComponent for coords when d.coords is truthy — actually correct (coords is a raw 'lat,lng' string used directly). Verified visually via the modal test.
Deep-linking via Linking.openURL to https://waze.com/ul and https://google.com/maps/dir works on web (opens in new tab) and on native (opens installed app). No expo-linking issues.
Console warning present: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — non-blocking, present across the app (RN Web deprecation).
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_iter11_courier_nav.py (new regression tests for courier nav modal)

If pending offer-modals appear on the courier home for stale test orders, call POST /api/orders/{oid}/offer-response with {accept:false} using the courier token, or refuse via UI (data-testid='offer-refuse'). The nav modal has testIDs: nav-modal (container), nav-google, nav-waze, nav-cancel. Reopen button after startRoute: entregador-reopen-maps. rca_of_issue: Original bug: on RN Web, Alert.alert with 3 buttons doesn't render the choice dialog (only 2-button dialogs are supported), so tapping 'Iniciar rota' silently did nothing when there were coords, or the button was disabled when no coords. Fix (verified): (1) replaced the 3-button Alert.alert('Abrir navegação', ..., [{Google Maps}, {Waze}, {Cancelar}]) with an in-app <Modal testID='nav-modal'> containing testIDs nav-google/nav-waze/nav-cancel, and (2) relaxed the canRoute predicate so the button also enables when the address has a street (without lat/lng), falling back to Google/Waze URL search-by-address (https://waze.com/ul?q=... and https://google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=<encodedQuery>). Verified both branches (coords branch triggered because QZY8PZ has lat/lng).
